v1.feedback: Strong conceptual morph — Twombly chalk-boids becoming wind-written leaves is exactly the right lineage. The tidal wind breathing and arc-stage labels (still→whisper→rustle→gust) land well narratively. Two refinements: the canopy oblate-ellipsoid reads as a generic sphere of points rather than a tree with branch structure — consider distributing leaves along 3-4 fractal branch paths so the silhouette reads as a specific tree species, not a cloud. Second, the straggler's extra wind susceptibility (windMult 2.2) could be more dramatic in the fall-and-return arc — let it spiral down with a visible corkscrew path before drifting back, so the eye tracks one protagonist leaf against the collective rustle.

v2.feedback: The psithurism concept lands well — wind-arc cycle (still→whisper→rustle→gust→hush) gives the piece genuine breathing room, and the palette (sage/olive/ochre/terra on parchment) is impeccable. Two refinements: first, 481 point-sprite leaves may read as sparse confetti rather than a rustling canopy — doubling count to ~900 and tightening the canopy spread would sell the tree silhouette faster; second, the Twombly lineage feels asserted in the comment but not visible in the render — consider adding a few chalk-scrawl line segments (THREE.Line with dashSize jitter) threading through the branches to keep the gestural DNA legible, not just narrated.
